senses.gloss:
येष् येष्, cl. 1. P. येषति, &c., Ved. to
boil up, bubble; to flow, leak; cl. 1. A.
येषते, &c., to exert one's self, endeavour, perse-
vere, = rt. पेष्, q. v.

येषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, boiling up, bubbling; flow-
ing, leaking; (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda III. 53, 22 = स्र-
वत्.)
येष्टिह येष्टिह, Ved. epithet of a Muhūrta.

येष्ठ येष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. fr. rt. 1. या),
going very quickly, moving with the greatest rapidity,
(Sāy. Ṛg-veda VII. 56, 6 = यातृतम, अतिशयेन
गन्तृ, but Ṛg-veda V. 41, 3 = यन्तृतम, re-
straining greatly, as if fr. rt. यम्.)
